# Volume 1 timeline

## CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised

**[Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Thomas](../character/thomas.md)** — Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) notices [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) dressed up and driving away from [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), sparking her curiosity. She visits [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to investigate and learns that the [Cuthberts](../codex/factions.md#cuthberts) are adopting an orphan boy from [Nova Scotia](../codex/places.md#nova-scotia). Mrs. Rachel voices strong disapproval and warnings about the risks of adoption before taking her leave.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P3](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P5](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0005), [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P16](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0016), [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P25](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0025)_

## CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised

**[Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md)** — [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) travels to [Bright River](../codex/places.md#bright-river) to pick up an expected orphan boy, only to discover that a talkative eleven-year-old girl has been sent instead. Deciding to let [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) handle the mistake, [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) invites the girl into his buggy and listens as she excitedly chats about her imagination and life experiences during the drive.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised P6](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0006), [v1 CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised P7](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0007), [v1 CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised P17](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0017), [v1 CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised P27](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0027)_

**[Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md)** — [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) drives the young orphan girl toward [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), listening to her imaginative ramblings about her red hair, the scenic surroundings, and her excitement to finally have a real home. As they pass through [Newbridge](../codex/places.md#newbridge), the [Avenue](../codex/places.md#avenue) (which she renames the [White Way of Delight](../codex/places.md#avenue)), and Barry's pond (which she renames the [Lake of Shining Waters](../codex/places.md#lake-of-shining-waters)), [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) feels growing dread about the disappointment awaiting her when [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) reveals she was brought by mistake.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised P44](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0044), [v1 CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised P53](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0053), [v1 CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised P70](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0070), [v1 CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised P74](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0074)_

## CHAPTER III. Marilla Cuthbert Is Surprised

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md)** — [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) is shocked to find [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) returned with a girl instead of the boy they requested. Devastated to learn she is unwanted, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) breaks down in tears, though [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) allows her to stay the night and puts her to bed in the east gable room. Afterward, [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) tentatively suggests keeping [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to help her, but [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) firmly insists she must be sent back.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER III. Marilla Cuthbert Is Surprised P1](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER III. Marilla Cuthbert Is Surprised P8](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER III. Marilla Cuthbert Is Surprised P39](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0039), [v1 CHAPTER III. Marilla Cuthbert Is Surprised P60](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0060)_

## CHAPTER IV. Morning at Green Gables

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), Snow Queen** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) wakes up at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and admires the scenery from her window before being called down to breakfast by [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md). After a quiet meal with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) helps with chores while reflecting on her uncertain future. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) prepares to drive [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to [White Sands](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel) to meet Mrs. [Spencer](../character/alexander-spencer.md), while [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) quietly signals his desire to keep [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER IV. Morning at Green Gables P0](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER IV. Morning at Green Gables P19](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0019), [v1 CHAPTER IV. Morning at Green Gables P27](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0027), [v1 CHAPTER IV. Morning at Green Gables P40](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0040)_

## CHAPTER V. Anne’s History

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md)** — During their drive along the shore road, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) asks [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) about her background. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) recounts her childhood history of being orphaned as a baby and shuffled between busy foster families and the asylum. Hearing Anne's story of hardship makes [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) feel a sudden pang of pity and reconsider whether they might keep her.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P8](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P11](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0011), [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P15](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0015), [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P21](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0021)_

## CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind

**[Alexander Spencer](../character/alexander-spencer.md), [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Blewett](../character/blewett.md), [Flora Jane](../character/flora-jane.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md)** — At Mrs. Spencer's home, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) learns that Mrs. [Blewett](../character/blewett.md) wants to take [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), but [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) dislikes Mrs. Blewett's harsh nature and decides to take [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) back home to discuss keeping her. Upon returning to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) agrees with [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) that they will keep and raise [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) themselves.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P19](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0019), [v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P20](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0020), [v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P29](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0029), [v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P31](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0031)_

## CHAPTER VII. Anne Says Her Prayers

**[Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md)** — [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) instructs [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) on tidiness and is shocked to discover that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) has never said prayers before. After asking [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to pray in her own words, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) hears [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) deliver an unconventional prayer expressing her desires and gratitude. Afterwards, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) discusses Anne's spiritual ignorance with [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) and resolves to begin her religious education immediately.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER VII. Anne Says Her Prayers P3](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER VII. Anne Says Her Prayers P4](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER VII. Anne Says Her Prayers P21](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0021), [v1 CHAPTER VII. Anne Says Her Prayers P29](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0029)_

## CHAPTER VIII. Anne’s Bringing-up Is Begun

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md)** — [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) informs [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) that she and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) have decided to keep her at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), leaving [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) overjoyed to tears. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) instructs [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to memorize the Lord's Prayer, sending her to her room after [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) repeatedly gets distracted by daydreams and conversation.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER VIII. Anne’s Bringing-up Is Begun P5](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0005), [v1 CHAPTER VIII. Anne’s Bringing-up Is Begun P6](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0006), [v1 CHAPTER VIII. Anne’s Bringing-up Is Begun P19](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0019), [v1 CHAPTER VIII. Anne’s Bringing-up Is Begun P48](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0048)_

## CHAPTER IX. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Properly Horrified

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md)** — Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) visits [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to meet [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), but offends the girl by rudely criticizing her appearance. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) flies into a furious temper outburst at Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), leading [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to send her to her room and demand an apology that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) stubbornly refuses to give.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER IX. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Properly Horrified P14](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0014), [v1 CHAPTER IX. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Properly Horrified P16](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0016), [v1 CHAPTER IX. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Properly Horrified P22](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0022), [v1 CHAPTER IX. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Properly Horrified P45](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0045)_

## CHAPTER X. Anne’s Apology

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md)** — [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) secretly visits [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) in her room and persuades her to apologize to Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) so she can leave her punishment. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) dramatically apologizes to Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), who forgives her completely and gives her flowers. As [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) walk back to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) feels a warm surge of affection for the girl despite her theatrical nature.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER X. Anne’s Apology P13](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0013), [v1 CHAPTER X. Anne’s Apology P30](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0030), [v1 CHAPTER X. Anne’s Apology P34](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0034), [v1 CHAPTER X. Anne’s Apology P50](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0050)_

## CHAPTER XI. Anne’s Impressions of Sunday-school

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Rogerson](../character/rogerson.md)** — [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) shows [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) three plain new dresses she has made for her, disappointing [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) who longs for fashionable puffed sleeves. The next day, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) goes to Sunday school alone, garnishing her hat with flowers along the way. She attends Miss Rogerson's class feeling out of place, and later reports back to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) about her day.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XI. Anne’s Impressions of Sunday-school P1](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XI. Anne’s Impressions of Sunday-school P9](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0009), [v1 CHAPTER XI. Anne’s Impressions of Sunday-school P17](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0017), [v1 CHAPTER XI. Anne’s Impressions of Sunday-school P18](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0018)_

## CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md)** — After [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) scolds [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) for her decorated church hat, she takes [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope) to meet [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md). The two girls quickly become best friends and swear a solemn oath of friendship. Returning home to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) excitedly tells [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) about [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) gives [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) a treat of chocolates.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P8](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P35](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0035), [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P40](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0040), [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P42](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0042)_

## CHAPTER XIII. The Delights of Anticipation

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md)** — [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) calls [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) inside for being late to her sewing work after talking with [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) excitedly tells [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) about an upcoming Sunday-school picnic, and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) agrees to let her attend and bake a food basket for her. Over the following days, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) bubbles with excitement about the event, while [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) worries [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) sets her heart too much on things.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIII. The Delights of Anticipation P0](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XIII. The Delights of Anticipation P2](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER XIII. The Delights of Anticipation P7](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0007), [v1 CHAPTER XIII. The Delights of Anticipation P18](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0018)_

## CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Harmon Andrews](../character/harmon-andrews.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md)** — [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) accuses [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) of losing her amethyst brooch and confines her to her room until she confesses. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) concocts a false confession in hopes of attending the picnic, but [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) forbids her from going anyway. Soon after, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) discovers the brooch caught in her shawl, realizes her mistake, and happily sends [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) off to enjoy the picnic after all.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P14](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0014), [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P35](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0035), [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P56](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0056), [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P62](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0062)_

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md)** — [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) admits her mistake regarding the brooch and forgives [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), allowing her to attend the Sunday-school picnic after all. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns home overjoyed by her wonderful day and shares the details with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), who later reflects on the incident with [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P62](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0062), [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P67](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0067), [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P68](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0068), [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P69](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0069)_

## CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Prissy Andrews](../character/prissy-andrews.md), [Tillie Boulter](../character/tillie-boulter.md), [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Julia Bell](../character/julia-bell.md), [Charlie Sloane](../character/charlie-sloane.md), [Josie Pye](../character/josie-pye.md), [Gertie Pye](../character/gertie-pye.md), [Phillips](../character/phillips.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) walk to school, discussing their scenic route, local school gossip, and the return of [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). In the classroom, Gilbert pulls Anne's braid and calls her 'Carrots,' prompting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to smash her slate over his head in anger. Mr. [Phillips](../character/phillips.md) punishes [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) by making her stand in front of the class, and despite Gilbert's contrite apology afterward, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) refuses to forgive him.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P3](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P33](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0033), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P38](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0038), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P44](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0044)_

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Charlie Sloane](../character/charlie-sloane.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Josie Pye](../character/josie-pye.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Phillips](../character/phillips.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md)** — After being punished by Mr. [Phillips](../character/phillips.md) and forced to sit with [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) refuses to return to school. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) consults Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), who advises letting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) stay home until she cools off. Later at home, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) laughs heartily after finding [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) weeping over an imagined future where [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) gets married.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P61](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0061), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P96](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0096)_

## CHAPTER XVI. Diana Is Invited to Tea with Tragic Results

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md)** — [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) gives [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) permission to invite [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) over for tea and treat her to raspberry cordial. While playing hostess at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accidentally serves [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) three glasses of Marilla's homemade currant wine instead of cordial, causing [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) to get dizzy and sick. After [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) leaves, Mrs. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) accuses [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) of getting her daughter drunk and forbids them from playing together, leaving [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) heartbroken until [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) realizes the mistake.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVI. Diana Is Invited to Tea with Tragic Results P7](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0007), [v1 CHAPTER XVI. Diana Is Invited to Tea with Tragic Results P25](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0025), [v1 CHAPTER XVI. Diana Is Invited to Tea with Tragic Results P42](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0042), [v1 CHAPTER XVI. Diana Is Invited to Tea with Tragic Results P48](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0048)_

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) tearfully explains to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) that Mrs. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) is furious because [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accidentally served [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) homemade currant wine instead of raspberry cordial, getting her drunk. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) goes to [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope) to explain the mistake, but Mrs. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) refuses to forgive [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) or let [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) play with her. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) personally begs Mrs. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) for forgiveness to no avail, returning to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) heartbroken.

## CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Gertie Pye](../character/gertie-pye.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Julia Bell](../character/julia-bell.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Minnie Andrews](../character/minnie-andrews.md), [Phillips](../character/phillips.md), [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md)** — [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) meets [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to say a tearful goodbye after her mother forbids them from playing together, leaving [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) devastated. To cope with her sorrow, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) decides to return to school, where she is warmly welcomed back by her classmates and secretly exchanges notes with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) throws herself into her studies, maintaining an intense academic rivalry with [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P0](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P16](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0016), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P28](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0028), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036)_

## CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md), [Young Mary Joe](../character/young-mary-joe.md)** — While [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) is away at a political rally, [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) rushes to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) because [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md) has severe croup and her parents are away. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) uses her experience with past foster children to nurse [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md) through the night until [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) arrives with a doctor. The doctor praises Anne's skill, and Mrs. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) forgives [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and invites her to resume her friendship with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P21](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0021), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P31](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0031), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P35](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0035), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P43](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0043)_

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md)** — [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) informs [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) that Mrs. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) has forgiven her and invited her over to visit [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md). An overjoyed [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) rushes off and returns later that evening, happily describing her joyous afternoon reuniting with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) and being treated like honored company by Mrs. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P43](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0043), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P46](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0046), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P48](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0048), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P51](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0051)_

## CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Carrie Sloane](../character/carrie-sloane.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Josephine Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Phillips](../character/phillips.md), [Prissy Andrews](../character/prissy-andrews.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md)** — [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) convinces [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to let [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) attend the [Debating Club](../codex/factions.md#debating-club) concert and spend the night with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md). After enjoying the concert, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) race into the spare-room bed and accidentally jump on Diana's elderly [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md). The next day, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) learns from Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) that [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md) is furious and threatening to leave.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P24](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0024), [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P48](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0048), [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P52](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0052), [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P58](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0058)_

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Josephine Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md)** — After speaking with Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) goes to [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope) to apologize directly to [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md) [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) for jumping onto her bed. Anne's honest confession and imaginative defense amuse Miss [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md), convincing her to forgive [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) and stay in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). Miss [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) become good friends throughout the rest of her visit.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P66](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0066), [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P79](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0079), [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P87](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0087), [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P90](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0090)_

## CHAPTER XX. A Good Imagination Gone Wrong

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) reflects on her first year at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) while [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) recovers from a headache. When [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) asks [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to fetch an apron pattern from the Barrys, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) reveals she and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) imagined the spruce wood was haunted, making her afraid of the dark. Unmoved, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) forces [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to walk through the [Haunted Wood](../codex/places.md#haunted-wood) to cure her of her fears.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XX. A Good Imagination Gone Wrong P12](../source/v01-c20.md#nw-v01-c20-p0012), [v1 CHAPTER XX. A Good Imagination Gone Wrong P20](../source/v01-c20.md#nw-v01-c20-p0020), [v1 CHAPTER XX. A Good Imagination Gone Wrong P30](../source/v01-c20.md#nw-v01-c20-p0030), [v1 CHAPTER XX. ## CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings

**[Allan](../character/allan.md), [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) prepare to host the new minister, Mr. [Allan](../character/allan.md), and his wife for tea at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) bakes a layer cake for the occasion and decorates the table with ferns and roses. During tea, [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) manages his shyness, but when Mrs. [Allan](../character/allan.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) taste Anne's cake, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) reacts in horror at its strange taste.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P15](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0015), [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P29](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0029), [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P31](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0031), [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P36](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0036)_

**[Allan](../character/allan.md), [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) decorates the tea table beautifully for the minister and his wife, but her layer cake turns out to be inedible because she accidentally flavored it with Anodyne Liniment instead of vanilla. Devastated by the mistake, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) flees to her room in tears. Mrs. [Allan](../character/allan.md) follows her upstairs to comfort her, kindly forgiving the error and showing her understanding as a kindred spirit.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P29](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0029), [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P43](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0043), [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P45](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0045), [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P50](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0050)_

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) comes home overjoyed after receiving an invitation to tea at the manse from Mrs. [Allan](../character/allan.md). Despite worrying about bad weather and etiquette, she has a wonderful afternoon and returns to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) in high spirits to recount the entire visit to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md).

## CHAPTER XXIII. Anne Comes to Grief in an Affair of Honor

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Carrie Sloane](../character/carrie-sloane.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Josie Pye](../character/josie-pye.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md), [Stacy](../character/stacy.md), [Superintendent Bell](../character/superintendent-bell.md)** — During a party, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accepts Josie Pye's dare to walk the ridgepole of Mr. Barry's roof, resulting in a fall that breaks her ankle. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) realizes how deeply she cares for [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) as the injured girl is brought home, and during her weeks of recovery, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) enjoys visits from friends while eagerly anticipating returning to school under their new teacher, Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md).

## CHAPTER XXIV. Miss Stacy and Her Pupils Get Up a Concert

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Carrie Sloane](../character/carrie-sloane.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Josie Pye](../character/josie-pye.md), [Julia Bell](../character/julia-bell.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md), [Stacy](../character/stacy.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to school in October and thrives under the guidance of her new teacher, Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md). She enthusiastically shares her school activities with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), including plans for an upcoming Christmas concert. While [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) remains skeptical of the festivities, [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) offers [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) his warm encouragement.

After an awkward attempt to shop at Lawson's store, he gets Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) to buy and sew a brown dress with puffed sleeves for her. On Christmas morning, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is overjoyed to receive the dress from [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), along with slippers sent by [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md), and she goes on to star in the successful evening concert.

## CHAPTER XXVII. Vanity and Vexation of Spirit

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md)** — [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) returns home to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to find that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) has failed to prepare tea. Upon investigating upstairs, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) discovers that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) dyed her hair green after purchasing a dye from a travelling peddler. After attempts to wash out the dye fail, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) is forced to cut Anne's hair off, though [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) resolves to take the mishap as a lesson in humility.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXVII. Vanity and Vexation of Spirit P2](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER XXVII. Vanity and Vexation of Spirit P16](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0016), [v1 CHAPTER XXVII. Vanity and Vexation of Spirit P28](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0028), [v1 CHAPTER XXVII. ## CHAPTER XXVIII. An Unfortunate Lily Maid

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and her friends reenact Tennyson's Elaine on a leaky flatboat, forcing [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to cling to a bridge pile until [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) rescues her. When Gilbert apologizes and asks to be friends, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) refuses, though she later reflects on her foolishness with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md).

## CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Josephine Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md)** — [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) invites [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to visit her [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md) in [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown) for the [Exhibition](../codex/places.md#exhibition). [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) allows [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to go, and Mr. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) drives the girls into town where they stay at [Beechwood](../codex/places.md#beechwood). After enjoying days at the fair, a concert, and exploring the city, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) are driven home, concluding that while city life was exciting, they are glad to be back.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life P11](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0011), [v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life P15](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0015), [v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life P22](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0022), [v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life P33](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0033)_

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Josephine Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) bid farewell to [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md), who realizes how much she enjoyed Anne's company. After a pleasant drive back, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), where [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) welcome her home with a hot supper as she recounts her trip.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life P31](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0031), [v1 CHAPTER XXIX. ## CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md)** — [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) informs [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) that Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md) visited to propose organizing a special Queen's [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) preparation class for advanced students. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) excitedly agrees to join, and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) promises to support her education.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P4](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P14](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0014), [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P16](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0016), [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P17](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0017)_

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Josie Pye](../character/josie-pye.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Moody Spurgeon MacPherson](../character/moody-spurgeon-macpherson.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md), [Stacy](../character/stacy.md)** — As the school term ends, Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md) reassures her students that she will return next year to prepare them for the [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) exams. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) resolves to spend her summer vacation playing and letting her imagination run free. Meanwhile, [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) visits [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) for tea and praises [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) for how remarkably well [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) has grown and improved over the past three years.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P32](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0032), [v1 CHAPTER XXX. ## CHAPTER XXXI. Where the Brook and River Meet

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) enjoys a restful summer before returning to her studies to prepare for the Queen's [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examination. As [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) grows taller and quieter, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) reflects emotionally on how fast she is growing up. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) talks with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) about her changing perspective on life, language, and writing under Miss Stacy's guidance.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXI. Where the Brook and River Meet P0](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XXXI. Where the Brook and River Meet P10](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0010), [v1 CHAPTER XXXI. Where the Brook and River Meet P16](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0016), [v1 CHAPTER XXXI. ## CHAPTER XXXII. The Pass List Is Out

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Stacy](../character/stacy.md), [Prissy Andrews](../character/prissy-andrews.md), [Josie Pye](../character/josie-pye.md), [Moody Spurgeon MacPherson](../character/moody-spurgeon-macpherson.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Allan](../character/allan.md)** — After finishing school, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) attends [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examinations in town, staying with [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md). Weeks later, [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) brings the official results showing that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) tied for first place on the Island. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) shares the triumphant news with [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), and Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) before ending her evening with Mrs. [Allan](../character/allan.md).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXII. The Pass List Is Out P0](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XXXII. The Pass List Is Out P40](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0040), [v1 CHAPTER XXXII. ## CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Billy](../character/billy.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Evans](../character/evans.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Josie Pye](../character/josie-pye.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md)** — [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) helps [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) dress for the charity concert at the [White Sands Hotel](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel), where [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) pops in to inspect her. After driving over with Jane and [Billy](../character/billy.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) feels insecure among the sophisticated attendees, but when overcome by stage fright on platform, the sight of [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) motivates her to perform splendidly and earn an encore.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P1](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P33](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0033), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P34](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0034)_

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Evans](../character/evans.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Billy](../character/billy.md), [Josie Pye](../character/josie-pye.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to the stage for an encore performance to avoid disappointing [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), winning over the audience and guests at the concert. Afterwards, she dines with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) and Jane, introduced to everyone by the pink lady, before [Billy](../character/billy.md) drives them home under the moonlight while they discuss the evening, wealth, and contentment.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P38](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0038), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P39](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0039), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. ## CHAPTER XXXIV. A Queen’s Girl

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Josie Pye](../character/josie-pye.md), [Frank Stockley](../character/frank-stockley.md), [Moody Spurgeon MacPherson](../character/moody-spurgeon-macpherson.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) departs [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to begin her studies at Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#academy) in town. After feeling lonely and homesick in her new boarding house room, she is visited by her [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) classmates and learns about the Avery scholarship, which sparks a new dream to attend Redmond College.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXIV. A Queen’s Girl P10](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0010), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIV. A Queen’s Girl P11](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0011), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIV. ## CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Frank Stockley](../character/frank-stockley.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Josephine Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md), [Josie Pye](../character/josie-pye.md), [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md), [Stella Maynard](../character/stella-maynard.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) settles into student life at Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#academy), forming close friendships and maintaining her healthy academic rivalry with [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). She spends time visiting [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md) [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) and eventually prepares alongside her [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) classmates as spring brings upcoming final examinations.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P7](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0007), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. ## CHAPTER XXXVI. The Glory and the Dream

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Josephine Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) learns that she has won the Avery scholarship while [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) wins the medal at Queen's. After Commencement, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns home to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), catches up with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), and notices concerning signs about Matthew's and Marilla's health, as well as worries about their bank.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXVI. The Glory and the Dream P7](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0007), [v1 CHAPTER XXXVI. The Glory and the Dream P17](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0017), [v1 CHAPTER XXXVI. The Glory and the Dream P28](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0028), [v1 CHAPTER XXXVI. ## CHAPTER XXXVII. The Reaper Whose Name Is Death

**[Alexander Spencer](../character/alexander-spencer.md), [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Charlie Sloane](../character/charlie-sloane.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [God](../character/god.md), [Josie Pye](../character/josie-pye.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Martin](../character/martin.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Moody Spurgeon MacPherson](../character/moody-spurgeon-macpherson.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md)** — [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) suddenly collapses and dies from the shock of reading about the Abbey Bank failure. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) grieve together and carry out Matthew's funeral with the support of neighbors. Afterwards, life slowly resumes at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) prepares to visit an eye specialist while chatting with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) about past memories.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXVII. The Reaper Whose Name Is Death P1](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XXXVII. The Reaper Whose Name Is Death P9](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0009), [v1 CHAPTER XXXVII. The Reaper Whose Name Is Death P20](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0020), [v1 CHAPTER XXXVII. The Reaper Whose Name Is Death P28](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0028)_

## CHAPTER XXXVIII. The Bend in the Road

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md)** — [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) returns with bad news about her failing sight, prompting her to consider selling [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) resolutely gives up her college scholarship to stay home, save Marilla's eyes, and teach locally. Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) reveals that [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) gave up the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school so [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) could have it, leading [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and Gilbert to finally reconcile their rivalry and become good friends.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXVIII. The Bend in the Road P4](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER XXXVIII. The Bend in the Road P14](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0014), [v1 CHAPTER XXXVIII. The Bend in the Road P18](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0018), [v1 CHAPTER XXXVIII.
